chapter.heading: Ezekiel 8
Abominations in the Temple
chapter.v: 8 In the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, with the elders of Judah sitting before me,the hand of the Lord God fell upon me there.

He put out the form of a hand and took me by a lock of my head, and the Spirit lifted me up between earth and heaven andbrought me invisions of God to Jerusalem,to the entrance of the gateway of the inner court that faces north,where was the seat of theimage of jealousy,which provokes to jealousy.
Then he said to me, “Son of man, lift up your eyes now toward the north.” So I lifted up my eyes toward the north, and behold, north of the altar gate, in the entrance, was thisimage of jealousy.

And he said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they are doing,the great abominations that the house of Israel are committing here,to drive me far from my sanctuary? But you will see still greater abominations.”
And he brought me to the entrance of the court, and when I looked, behold, there was a hole in the wall.
